biggest_catch: Your friend must get $250 or more in real payroll/pension/Social Security direct deposits within 60 days (Zelle, Venmo, and bank transfers don't count), or nobody gets anything.
catches: Friend must apply for membership online using your unique referral link, become a member, open a savings account and a checking account, and set up direct deposit.

The friend must receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $250+ within 60 days of account opening; qualifying DD is electronic payroll/pension/government-benefit deposits only - Zelle, Venmo, wire transfers, ATM deposits and online/mobile transfers do NOT qualify.
Promotion cannot be combined with any other promotions.
Both parties must be 18+ California residents; both must be in good standing at qualification verification.
Referring members are limited to 8 completed and qualified referrals ($400) during the promotional period, April 8, 2026 through December 31, 2026.
Golden 1 may review referrals for abuse and deny rewards; accounts closed or not in good standing at verification are not rewarded.

steps: Share your unique Golden 1 referral link with a friend (must be 18+ and a CA resident).
Your friend applies for Golden 1 membership online using your referral link and becomes a member.
The friend opens a traditional savings account ($1 minimum) and a checking account and sets up direct deposit.
Within 60 days of account opening, the friend receives qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, or Social Security electronic deposits) totaling $250 or more.

You receive a $50 Visa egift card emailed to your Golden 1 membership email within 15 business days of qualification verification - up to 8 referrals ($400) during the April 8 to December 31, 2026 promotion.
timing: $50 Visa egift cards emailed to both the new member and referring member within 15 business days of qualification verification, provided the qualifying direct deposit is received within 60 days and accounts are open and in good standing.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $50 Visa egift cards emailed to both the new member and referring member within 15 business days of qualification verification, provided the qualifying direct deposit is received within 60 days and accounts are open and in good standing. — the friend's qualification window runs up to 60 days and the payout clock starts only after.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
